data.name: Skills_Stack_NoProject
data.value: No project: there are no technologies to detect.

data.name: Skills_Stack_None
data.value: No technology is recognized from the names of the files.

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoAssisted
data.value: The assisted recommendation is missing. Only the deterministic one is there, which spends no usage limit.

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoApproval
data.value: The approval dialog is missing: without it the OK of the assisted recommendation cannot be asked.

data.name: Skills_Notice_CodexGlobal
data.value: Codex also loads your global skills (~/.agents/skills). Turning one on here only adds: it does not hide the ones you already have.

data.name: Skills_Notice_OpenProject
data.value: Open a project to turn skills on: without one you can only browse the catalog.

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoStore
data.value: The store of the project is missing: nothing can be turned on or seen as on.

data.name: Skills_Notice_OpenFailed
data.value: The project could not be opened, so nothing can be turned on: {0}

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoCatalog
data.value: The catalog of skills is missing: there is nothing to show.

data.name: Skills_Notice_CatalogFailed
data.value: The catalog of skills could not be read: {0}

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoTemplate
data.value: The template of agents is missing: only the Global and Project scopes can be turned on.

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoTemplateYet
data.value: The project has no template of agents yet (the Orchestrator creates the default one when it opens). Until then there are only Global and Project scopes.

data.name: Skills_Notice_TemplateFailed
data.value: The template of agents could not be read: {0}

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoActivations
data.value: The store of activations is missing: nothing can be turned on or seen as on.

data.name: Skills_Notice_ActivationsFailed
data.value: The activations could not be read: {0}

data.name: Skills_Notice_NoHealth
data.value: The health reader of the skills is missing: all of them show "not checked".

data.name: Skills_Notice_FilesFailed
data.value: The files of the project could not be listed to detect its technologies: {0}

data.name: Skills_Unusable_Both

data.value: {0} linked skill cannot be given to an agent

data.value: {0} linked skills cannot be given to an agent

data.name: Skills_UnusableNoCopy_One
data.value: {0} skill without a valid local copy cannot be given to an agent

data.name: Skills_UnusableNoCopy_Other
data.value: {0} skills without a valid local copy cannot be given to an agent

data.name: Skills_Card_LinkedWarning
data.value: It is linked: the index keeps no local copy. So it cannot be given to any agent or turned on here. To use it, add a local copy to your index.

data.name: Skills_Card_Cost
data.value: ~{0} tokens in each run where it is on. Estimated by Agent Studio: characters of the name and the description, divided by {1}.

data.name: Skills_Activation_SaveFailed
data.value: The decision could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Skills_Recommend_None
data.value: No skill matches the task or the technologies of the project.

data.name: Skills_Recommend_Some
data.value: {0} recommended, spending no usage limit. Nothing was turned on.

data.name: Skills_Assisted_NotGiven
data.value: Nothing was asked: you did not give the OK, so no usage limit was spent.

data.name: Skills_Assisted_Proposed_One
data.value: The agent proposed 1 skill{0}. Nothing was turned on: turn it on yourself in its card if you like it.

data.name: Skills_Assisted_Proposed_Other
data.value: The agent proposed {0} skills{1}. Nothing was turned on: turn them on yourself in their cards if you like them.

data.name: Skills_Assisted_Failed
data.value: The recommendation could not be requested: {0}

data.name: Skills_Assisted_Cancelled
data.value: The question was cancelled: nothing was asked.

data.name: Skills_View_ShowCard
data.value: Show its card in the tree

data.name: Skills_View_ActivationHelp
data.value: Adds a decision of yours for this scope. The previous one stays in the history.

data.name: Skills_View_ActivationNote
data.value: Turning on adds a decision of yours and does not delete the earlier ones. The most specific scope wins: first Agent, then Project, then Global. With no decision, the skill is off.

data.name: Skills_View_ReloadTip
data.value: Reads the index, the template of agents and the decisions again

data.name: Skills_View_SearchTip
data.value: Searches by name, summary and tags, ignoring case and accents

data.name: Skills_View_WarningsDetailName
data.value: Detail of the warnings of the index

data.name: Skills_View_WarningsToggleHelp
data.value: Shows or hides each warning of the skills index

data.name: Skills_View_WarningsSummaryName
data.value: Summary of the warnings of the index

data.name: Skills_View_Pick
data.value: Pick a skill in the tree to see its card: source, health, cost and activation.

data.name: Skills_View_Allow
data.value: Allow the assisted recommendation (spends usage limit of Claude)

data.name: Skills_View_AskNote
data.value: Each use asks for your OK. Claude (model haiku) reads the catalog locally, read only, with no network or files. It only proposes.

data.name: Info_Skills_What
data.value: Skills are instructions and resources given to an agent so it works better. Here you see the catalog, the health of each skill and which agents receive it.

data.name: Info_Skills_Actions
data.value: Pick a skill in the tree to see its card. Turn it on for the project, for an agent or globally: each decision is saved and can be changed. Ask for a recommendation for your task. The deterministic one spends no usage limit; the one of an agent does. Look at the cost: each skill that is on adds tokens to every run.
